pipeline_target: PDF/image -> OMR -> validated notation model -> MusicXML
note: This is a symbol metadata registry, not a trained OMR model or labeled image dataset. MusicXML mappings, glyph rendering previews, image training samples, and validation rules must be added in subsequent steps.
licensing_review: Review the SMuFL specification/data attribution and font licensing before bundling any font files. Metadata is kept separate from Bravura font assets.
